title: Contractor Lead Engine
summary: Self-hosted pipeline that builds ICP-scored contractor leads from public license data and company sites—with verified contacts and evidence-linked outreach drafts.
problem: Outbound teams waste budget on bounced emails, duplicates, and poor-fit companies—and need a small sample they can trust before scaling a list.
solution: FastAPI app ingests California CSLB-style license records, dedupes by domain/phone/address, crawls sites for owner contacts, verifies email status (ok-only export by default), scores fit against YAML ICP rules with LLM grounding, and drafts a first line tied to a verifiable fact. Ships CSV/JSON quality reports and optional HubSpot or Sheets adapters.
